from pathlib import Path
progdir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u048/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v}
    boxes = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells); r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells); c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        # Each colored object is a rectangular frame enclosing an interior pattern.
        ih, iw = r1-r0-1, c1-c0-1
        if ih > 0 and iw > 0:
            pat = [[grid[r][c] == color for c in range(c0+1,c1)] for r in range(r0+1,r1)]
            boxes.append((color,r0,r1,c0,c1,ih,iw,pat))
    patterned = [b for b in boxes if any(any(row) for row in b[7])]
    if not patterned:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The largest nonempty interior is the design to copy; smaller interior marks are distractors.
    src = max(patterned, key=lambda b: b[5]*b[6])
    sh, sw, pattern = src[5], src[6], src[7]
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for color,r0,r1,c0,c1,ih,iw,_ in boxes:
        if (ih,iw) != (sh,sw):
            continue
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            out[r0][c] = color; out[r1][c] = color
        for r in range(r0,r1+1):
            out[r][c0] = color; out[r][c1] = color
        for dr in range(sh):
            for dc in range(sw):
                if pattern[dr][dc]: out[r0+1+dr][c0+1+dc] = color
    return out
'''
f=progdir/'task-ea9ab1fe.py'; f.write_text(code)
print(f, f.exists())
